emulatorSimulation.renderingLimitation: On this headless host the emulator process segfaulted (exit 139) whenever the Flutter app rendered through the emulator GPU paths (swiftshader_indirect and guest, emulator 36.4.10 and 37.x); a control session typing into system Settings did not crash. Launching with the Flutter debug engine flags enable-software-rendering=true, enable-impeller=false avoided it. Real-device GPU rendering is unaffected by this host limitation and is not qualified here.
